title.ko: 복잡한 글 요약과 바꿔 쓰기: in essence · gist · restate · condense · distil · reword
title.en: summarising and paraphrasing complex texts: in essence, gist, restate, condense, distil, reword

explain.ko: 요약(summary)은 원문의 핵심 논지(central argument)와 근거를 짧게 줄이는 일로, 세부 사항과 예시는 생략합니다. 바꿔 쓰기(paraphrase)는 원문의 의미를 자신의 어휘와 구조로 다시 표현하는 일입니다. 둘 다 원문을 정확히 이해해야 하며, 원문을 거의 그대로 옮기거나 출처를 밝히지 않으면 표절(plagiarism)이 됩니다. In essence, ...와 같은 표현으로 요지를 간결하게 제시하세요.
explain.en: A summary shortens the central argument and evidence of the original, omitting details and examples. Paraphrase restates the meaning of the original in your own vocabulary and structure. Both require an accurate understanding of the original, and copying it nearly word for word or failing to acknowledge the source is plagiarism. Use expressions such as In essence, ... to present the gist concisely.

items.passage:
STUDY GUIDE
How to summarise
First read the text closely and find the central argument. Omit details and examples and keep only the evidence. Finally, rewrite it in your own words and compare it with the original to check that the meaning has not changed.

task.model: In essence, this paper argues that technology is changing education. The key evidence is the growth in learning data. The writer therefore calls for the role of teachers to be redefined. Paraphrased, the writer says the teacher's role must be defined anew.
